title: Transport of normalized primitive realizations between reduction calculi
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an algebra map $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:V\to W$ be any scheme morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. In the ambient derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $S,T$ be two whole-system reduction calculi on $(E,W)$ with their actual adjunctions to the same total-limit functor $\mathcal L_{E,W}$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Write $a:S.\mathcal R\xrightarrow\sim T.\mathcal R$ for the canonical uniqueness isomorphism of left adjoints. Use the specified derived whole-system pullback $U_f$ and scalar extension $S_\iota$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Fix normalized Roos models $\rho$ on $(E,V)$ and $\sigma$ on $(L,W)$, a normalized primitive pullback model $U$ for $f$ with reduction calculus $T$ and Roos model $\rho$, and a normalized primitive scalar model $B$ for $\iota$ with reduction calculus $T$ and Roos model $\sigma$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Then both assertions hold: (1) for every primitive pullback model $M$ normalized for $S,\rho$ and every ambient derived object $K$ on $(E,W)$, $b_{M,K};\mathcal L_{E,V}(U_f(a_K))=b_{U,K}$; (2) for every primitive scalar model $M$ normalized for $S,\sigma$ and every such $K$, $b_{M,K};\mathcal L_{L,W}(S_\iota(a_K))=b_{B,K}$. These are equalities of whole-system realization morphisms, with all quotient transitions retained. No completeness, constructibility, isomorphism condition on $f$, or flatness of finite quotient coefficient maps is assumed.

proof.text: The two reduction evaluation comparisons are compatible with a. Transpose their difference by the finite reduction adjunction. The calculus unit-projection equations, naturality of the system projection and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identify the transposes. Injectivity of the finite Hom equivalence proves the evaluation equality. Hence a strict quotient presentation for S transports to T by a inverse followed by the same presentation, retaining the same finite strict isomorphisms and generator formulas.

The coherence equation of a whole-system presentation transports as well. Expand it as the constant-tower image of the adjunction unit followed by the total-limit image of the presentation and the actual tower counit. Functoriality and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identify this unit/presentation composite for T with that for S. Reuse the same strict augmentation witness.

Transport the normalized T pullback and scalar models back to S by postcomposing their realization isomorphisms with the system-operation/limit image of a inverse. For each S-presentation use the corresponding T-presentation from the preceding steps. The normalization field of the T-model supplies the same strict quotient-system isomorphism and generator formula; functoriality gives its required Roos realization equation. These are honest constructed normalized S-models. Apply primitiveQuotientRealizations_unique to identify any supplied S-model realization with the constructed one.

Evaluate each realization equality at K and postcompose with the total-limit image of the appropriate operation applied to a_K. The canonical comparison from T to S followed by that from S to T is the identity (leftAdjointUniq_trans_app and leftAdjointUniq_refl). Functoriality and the identity law cancel these factors. This gives both stated morphism equations. For S=T this is identity transport; the same proof includes zero objects, identity morphisms and ramified coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem realizations_transport
    {V W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W)
    (S T : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (ρ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l E V) (σ : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L W)
    (U : IntegralComparisonPullbackModel l E f T ρ)
    (B : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι W T σ) :
    (∀ (M : IntegralComparisonPullbackModel l E f S ρ)
      (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W)),
      M.realization.hom.app K ≫ (coefficientSequenceLimit l E V).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f).map
            ((S.adjunction.leftAdjointUniq T.adjunction).hom.app K)) =
        U.realization.hom.app K) ∧
    (∀ (M : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι W S σ)
      (K : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W)),
      M.realization.hom.app K ≫ (coefficientSequenceLimit l L W).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι W).map
            ((S.adjunction.leftAdjointUniq T.adjunction).hom.app K)) =
        B.realization.hom.app K)
